rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for aspirin, including the drug and an aspirin tablet.

example.english: I took an aspirin for my headache, and I feel much better.
example.traditional: 頭痛我食咗一粒阿士匹靈，舒服好多。
example.jyutping: tau4 tung3 ngo5 sik6 zo2 jat1 lap1 aa3 si6 pat1 ling4 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1
